EC1: Past history of hypersensitivity [AND] to aripiprazole
EC2: Primary diagnosis of MDD [OR] with psychotic feature [OR], bipolar disorder [OR], schizophrenia [OR], schizoaffective disorder [OR], other psychotic disorder [OR] or anxiety disorder, [OR] a history of alcohol [OR]/ drug abuse [OR] within the past 12 months, or a diagnosis of dementia
EC3: Clinically significant current Axis II (DSM-IV-TR) diagnosis
EC4: A significant risk of suicide [AND] corroborated by a score of =5 on item 10(suicidal thoughts) on the MADRS scale or by clinical judgment of the investigator
EC6: Presence of a serious medical illness including cardiac, hepatic, renal, respiratory, endocrinologic, neurologic, or hematologic disease or physical disorder judged to significantly affect central nervous system function
EC7: Patients taking antipsychotics [OR], mood stabilizer [OR] or any psychotropic medications [NOT] besides antidepressants, [NOT] except benzodiazepines [OR] or beta blockers [OR] or hypnotics
EC8: Patients with past treatment failures of aripiprazole
